name: Document Realm
summary:
Document Realm is a comprehensive document creation and editing app, optimized specifically for Meta Quest 2 and 3 devices. Create, edit, and manage rich text documents with an immersive VR-powered interface designed for productivity and comfort.

Key Features: Experience professional document editing with full rich text formatting, including bold, italics, underlining, text colors, font sizes, and alignment options. The collapsible toolbar maximizes your writing space while keeping essential controls acces
